title: The Cafe Across the Cell Boundary
description: A cafe is 20 metres from a user but falls in a neighboring geohash cell. Searching only the user's cell misses it. What should the query do?

options.text: Fetch the cell and relevant neighbors, then filter by exact distance.
options.explanation: Cell boundaries do not match distance circles. Candidate cells avoid boundary misses; exact-distance filtering removes points outside the radius.

options.text: Use a longer geohash and still query only one cell.
options.explanation: Smaller cells do not remove boundaries and can make a one-cell search miss more nearby points.

options.text: Treat a shared prefix as an exact distance measurement.
options.explanation: A prefix identifies a region, not a point-to-point distance.

options.text: Sort the containing cell's results by rating.
options.explanation: Ranking existing candidates cannot recover a cafe excluded before ranking.
